claim: On April 29, 2026 the Senate PSI, chaired by Ron Johnson, held the hearing 'Unmasked' and released ~600 pages of HHS-produced FDA records; Johnson has framed the episode as 'the biggest scandal in my lifetime,' asserting 'at least tens of thousands died' after March 2021 — a figure drawn from spontaneous VAERS reports, which record events after vaccination without establishing that the vaccine caused them.

sources.label: PSI hearing 'Unmasked: How Biden Health Officials Purposely Turned a Blind Eye Toward COVID-19 Vaccine Safety Signals' — Senate HSGAC subcommittee hearing page (witnesses: David Wiseman, Karl Jablonowski, Maria Young), Apr. 29, 2026
Full hearing video (1h57m) — Sen. Ron Johnson / Rumble release, May 26, 2026

notes: Group B/C framing record for capture DZc_PksR06G (Ron Johnson confronting CNN in a Capitol press gaggle, posted by @cheering4change June 11 2026). Verified facts: the hearing happened (Apr 29 2026, PSI, witnesses Wiseman/Jablonowski/Young — all outside experts/advocates, NOT the FDA officials, who did not testify; the case rests on their emails); HHS under Sec. Kennedy produced ~600 pages to PSI. CONTESTED/Group C in Johnson's gaggle: 'at least tens of thousands died after that March 1st date' and 'millions suffered adverse events' — these conflate VAERS spontaneous reports (the report itself references 'more than 2,900 deaths worldwide' reported to VAERS) with confirmed vaccine-caused deaths; a reported death in VAERS is a temporal report, not an adjudicated causal finding. 'Biggest scandal in my lifetime' / 'major media ignoring it' are Johnson's rhetorical characterizations. The full 1h57m hearing is archived (machine transcript) at sources/captures/DZc_PksR06G/hearing/. Companion documented records: -001 (the masked-signals finding), -002 (the cease-and-desist email).
